targets.old_statement: The depicted straight arm extending outward through the driver window signals a left turn.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The depicted straight arm extending outward through the driver window signals a left turn.
targets.statement: When a vehicle's electronic signals are not working, drivers must give the required left-turn hand signal through the driver's side window.

targets.old_statement: The depicted arm bent upward at the elbow signals a right turn.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The depicted arm bent upward at the elbow signals a right turn.
targets.statement: When a vehicle's electronic signals are not working, drivers must give the required right-turn hand signal through the driver's side window, and road-test applicants must know all three hand signals.

targets.old_statement: The depicted arm angled downward signals slowing or stopping.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The depicted arm angled downward signals slowing or stopping.
targets.statement: When a vehicle's electronic signals are not working, drivers must give the hand signal for slowing or stopping through the driver's side window, whereas bicyclists may signal with either arm.
